messages:
sonia (partnerships): quick sync: KeyHarbor (HW KMS vendor) wants to appear in the Redwood marketplace during our May partner weeks. they support HSM attestation, SCIM provisioning, and SAML SSO. goal: soft-launch + a joint demo next month. who owns technical sign-off?

ev an (security): evan (security): hello — security sign-off needs: HSM attestation docs, CI test proving key wrap compatibility, and separation of control for customer-provided keys (BYOK). also need proof that audit logs are tamper-evident.

marco (eng): i can run the compatibility tests. can KeyHarbor give us a test vector and a sample wrapped key flow? ideally a small curl example we can exercise in our staging tenant.

sonia (partnerships): they sent an example earlier: 
```
POST https://api.keyharbor.example.com/v1/wrap
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <partner-token>
Body: {"plaintext_key": "base64(DEK)"}
```
response includes: wrap_algo, wrapped_key_b64, key_id

anya (product): product needs the marketplace metadata: supported features (SAML, SCIM, HSM, BYOK, key-rotation-hooks), pricing model (per-key + per-API-call), and a short 1-paragraph description for the listing. also: feature flag to mark BYOK as beta until we finish rotation tests.

ev an (security): add to checklist: key rotation test, replay protection on wrap calls, signed certificate chain from HSM vendor, and a minimal threat model doc. i'll draft checklist now.

marco (eng): for staging we need an ephemeral tenant. ops-bot can you create kh-partner-stg-01 and add the KeyHarbor contact?

ops-bot: provisioning task created: tenant kh-partner-stg-01. owner: sonia. expires: 72h. invite: ops-bot@redwood.app will add keyharbor@vendor.com. link: https://staging.console.redwood/tenants/kh-partner-stg-01

sonia (partnerships): legal flagged export controls for HSM material and wants a 72-hour review for any co-marketing language. they also asked for the embargo date. propose embargo lift = 2025-05-20 00:00 PT.

ev an (security): security checklist (draft):
- HSM attestation: vendor-provided certs and firmware versions
- Wrap/unwrap API: success/failure codes + rate limits documented
- BYOK model: envelope encryption flow, keys under customer control, proof of rewrap on rotation
- Rotation test: rotate wrapping key and ensure seamless decryption of stored secrets
- Audit: signed, append-only events for wrap/unwrap/rotate with requester ID
- Latency: median wrap <60ms, p99 <200ms in staging
- Replay protection: nonce/timestamp validation on wrap requests

marco (eng): thanks. i'll run the curl flow and capture HAR + timings. i'll test SCIM create/deprovision and a SAML assertion for r-roles mapping.

anya (product): i'll prepare the marketplace draft copy and mark BYOK as beta until rotation is green. also will schedule the demo slot for week of May 26.

sonia (partnerships): next steps: 1) staging run with KeyHarbor tomorrow 10am PT (marco) 2) evan to finalize checklist by EOD 3) legal to review embargo and co-marketing copy (sonia -> legal) 4) product to prepare listing draft (anya). i'll follow up after the staging run. :rocket:

marco (eng): invite sent to keyharbor@vendor.com. will paste results here after tests.

ops-bot: keyharbor@vendor.com joined tenant kh-partner-stg-01. ephemeral creds posted to tenant console.
